
		<h2>
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/laxor/p/21622432" title="发布于 2026-07-18 15:23">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">如何解决 机械革命 蛟龙16Pro 触摸板失灵问题</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>尝试了网上的方法，但对我的电脑无效，型号是蛟龙16 Pro 潮玩版，R9-9955HX，RTX5060。</p>
<p>亲测可行的方法如下：</p>
<p>开机按F2，进入BIOS界面，用手在触摸板上滑动，相当于激活一下触摸板，然后控制箭头，点击Boot，正常开机，进入Win11系统，触摸板就好了，就这么简单！</p>
<p style="text-align: center"><img alt="image" width="527" height="380" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1998934/202607/1998934-20260718151958347-794519772.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;补充一下：</p>
<p>1. 简单的禁用再启用触摸板，是没用的。</p>
<p style="text-align: center"><img alt="image" width="523" height="109" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1998934/202607/1998934-20260718150019024-281454594.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>2. 触摸板属于人体学输入设备，不是鼠标和其他指针设备。</p>
<p>3. 当触摸板失灵时，在Windows的设备管理器中，根本看不到 I2C HID设备，无法通过右键点击，卸载或更新驱动。</p>
<p style="text-align: center"><img alt="image" width="681" height="584" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1998934/202607/1998934-20260718144737997-1505369637.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>4. 蛟龙16 Pro没有单独的触摸板驱动，而是合并在AMD的芯片组驱动中。</p>
<p align="center"><strong>AMD Software Release Notes ver. 7.05.21.303</strong></p>
<table style="height: 130px; width: 747px" border="1" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
<tbody>
<tr style="height: 12px">
<td width="277">
<p><strong>Driver Name</strong></p>
</td>
<td width="222">
<p><strong>OS Supported</strong></p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="161">
<p><strong>Supported Version</strong></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr style="height: 12px">
<td width="277">
<p>AMD PCI Device Driver</p>
</td>
<td width="222">
<p>Windows 11(64-bit)</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="161">
<p>1.0.0.90</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr style="background-color: rgba(244, 236, 112, 1)">
<td width="277">
<p>AMD I2C Driver</p>
</td>
<td width="222">
<p>Windows 11(64-bit)</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="161">
<p>1.2.0.126</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr style="height: 12px">
<td width="277">
<p>AMD GPIO2 Driver</p>
</td>
<td width="222">
<p>Windows 11(64-bit)</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="161">
<p>2.2.0.134</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr style="height: 12px">
<td width="277">
<p>AMD PSP Driver</p>
</td>
<td width="222">
<p>Windows 11(64-bit)</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="161">
<p>5.39.0.0</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>即使重新安装安装一次 I2C 驱动，也没用。</p>
<p style="text-align: center"><img alt="image" width="676" height="473" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1998934/202607/1998934-20260718145512018-40508738.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;5. 大概率不是硬件损坏，最简单、最直接的方法就是重启电脑，在BIOS中，摸一下触摸板，唤醒它，就可以了。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
